winged-arrow: A slender arrow pointing to the lower right, flanked by long curved barbed feather blades sweeping along both sides of its shaft.
winged-emblem: A pair of outspread feathered wings flanking a four-pointed star set in a circle, a military or aviation-style badge.
winged-leg: A feathered wing joined to a clawed talon with curved toes.
winged-scepter: An upright rod topped by a ringed orb enclosing a crescent, flanked by two layered outspread wings.
winged-shield: A pointed heraldic shield flanked by pairs of sweeping feathered wings.
winged-sword: A downward-pointing sword flanked by layered feathered wings sweeping out from its crossguard.
wingfoot: A boot in profile with a long feathered wing sweeping back from its heel, the winged sandal associated with Hermes and swiftness.
winter-gloves: A pair of thick mittens with ribbed cuffs and separate thumbs.
winter-hat: A knitted beanie with a ribbed brim and a round pompom at its peak.
wire-coil: A spool wound with many turns of wire, with a loose length of it curving away to one side.
wireframe-globe: A globe drawn as a grid of latitude and longitude lines within a circle.
wisdom: A bearded face with spiky radiating hair and slit eyes, rising from shoulders.
witch-face: A hooded figure in a wide-brimmed pointed hat with a long hooked nose and streaming hair.
witch-flight: A silhouetted witch in a pointed hat riding a broomstick, shown in reverse against a full circular moon.
wizard-face: A bearded face under a drooping pointed hat, with long mustaches and a squared beard.
wizard-staff: A long staff whose head curls into a thick volute spiral, in the manner of a mage's or shepherd's crook.
wok: A deep round-bottomed wok with a small side grip and a long straight handle rising diagonally.
wolf-head: Snarling wolf head in profile with bared jagged teeth, spiky ruff of fur and a lightning-bolt marking on its cheek.
wolf-howl: A wolf's head thrown back in a howl, silhouetted against a full moon disc.
wolf-trap: A steel jaw trap with two rows of sharp teeth and a round pressure plate on its pan.
wolverine-claws: Two sets of long tapering blades crossing each other in an X, leaving small diamond gaps where they overlap.
woman-elf-face: A woman's face with long hair, pointed upswept ears and a small gem on her brow, a stock depiction of an elf.
wood-axe: A hatchet with a broad flared blade and a short haft angling down from it.
wood-beam: A long squared timber beam angled across the frame, its end grain showing concentric growth rings.
wood-cabin: A log cabin with a steep gabled roof, a central door, shuttered windows, and stacked log ends at the corners, with a chimney puffing smoke.
wood-canoe: A slender canoe seen from the side with upswept pointed ends and visible interior planking.
wood-club: A tapering wooden club whose head bristles with jagged spikes and splintered points.
wood-frame: Four wooden planks and clothespin-like slats laid to form a rough square border.
wood-pile: A stack of cut logs, some showing round end grain with concentric rings and others lying lengthwise.
wood-stick: A tapering tree branch with several small side twigs, thicker at the lower end where a knob sits.
wooden-chair: A chair seen from the front, with a curved top rail over three back slats, a broad seat, two legs and a stretcher.
wooden-clogs: A pair of overlapping wooden clogs seen from the side, with high curved toes and open backs.
wooden-crate: A square shipping crate with diagonal bracing planks and studded corner reinforcements.
wooden-door: An arch-topped door made of vertical planks bound by two horizontal cross-bands, with a round handle and studs along the edge.
wooden-fence: A fence panel of pointed vertical planks joined by two horizontal rails.
wooden-helmet: A wide hollow tree stump with a notched rim, with splintered shards flying off to either side.
wooden-pegleg: A boot on a lower leg with bare bones above it, beside a tapering wooden peg leg with a cup-shaped socket.
wooden-pier: A boardwalk of long planks receding toward the horizon between two mooring posts, with a horizontal band above marking the skyline.
wooden-sign: A signpost on a single post, bearing two stacked crooked planks with blank faces.
wool: A ball of yarn wound with visible strands, pierced by two knitting needles, with a loose thread trailing from it.
world: A circle filled with irregular landmass shapes suggesting continents and seas, a globe of the world.
worm-mouth: A ringed circular maw with concentric rows of teeth surrounded by broad rounded lobes.
worms: A tangle of short curved dashes and segments winding across the field, suggesting a mass of crawling worms.
worried-eyes: A pair of eyes with heavy arched upper lids that dip toward the nose, giving an anxious expression.
wrapped-heart: A heart crossed by ragged diagonal bands that break it into offset slices.
wrapped-sweet: A round candy with twisted wrapper ends flaring at each side.
wrapping-star: A four-pointed star of curved tapering blades sweeping outward toward the corners like a pinwheel.
wrecking-ball: A heavy spherical wrecking ball hanging from a short length of chain.
wrench: A double-ended wrench with open forked jaws at the top and bottom of a straight shaft.
wyvern: A two-legged winged dragon with spread bat wings, a horned head and a long tail.
xylophone: A striped necktie with a knot at the top, tapering to a point.
yarn: A bundled skein of yarn banded at its middle, with a long wavy strand trailing loose from one end.
yin-yang: Five graduated xylophone bars each marked with round pegs, with two crossed beaters below.
yunluo: A frame of two uprights and a crossbar with a curved crest, holding six round gongs suspended in two rows.
z-brick: Four square blocks joined in an S/Z-shaped stair arrangement, a tetromino piece.
zat-gun: A slender curved handheld weapon with a tapered barrel and a small round port, shaped like a coiled serpent.
zebra-shield: A shield shape filled with bold curving zebra stripes.
zeppelin: An airship with an elongated envelope, tail fins at the left and a small gondola beneath.
zeus-sword: A straight sword crossed with a jagged lightning bolt and a curved blade, an emblem of Zeus as god of thunder.
zig-arrow: A broad arrow pointing down-right, its shaft broken into a series of zigzag segments.
zigzag-cage: A circle streaked with slanted lines, crossed by a thick lightning-like zigzag band anchored by round knobs at opposite edges.
zigzag-hieroglyph: Two stacked horizontal zigzag lines, the conventional sign for water or waves.
zigzag-leaf: A broad pointed leaf on a curving stem, its interior marked by sweeping crescent-shaped veins.
zigzag-tune: A beamed pair of musical notes whose connecting beams zigzag sharply between the stems.
zipper: A zipper pull tab and slider with a dashed V of teeth spreading upward from it.
